{{Vanilla|Bell}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''bell''' is a village block. Vanilla bells cannot be crafted; [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a recipe.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Seven [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]] around a lightning rod make a bell.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bell.json}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses|none=A bell is not an ingredient in any recipe; it works as in vanilla.}}
Unlike in vanilla, [[piglin]]s don't admire bells: the pack replaces the <code>piglin_loved</code> item tag with a list that leaves them out.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/piglin_loved.json}}</ref>
